hook: A new 50-page report claims classified Epstein files are missing.

sections.voiceover: A new 50-page report claims classified Epstein files are missing.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of a government document with redacted text.

sections.voiceover: On October 26, 2026, House Judiciary Committee Democrats released a report accusing Donald Trump of participating in Jeffrey Epstein’s sex scheme. These accounts include 11 women who say they were trafficked. Where did the missing classified documents go?
sections.visual_cue: Graphic showing the House Judiciary Committee seal and the number 11.

sections.voiceover: CBS News identified 3 classified documents that the Department of Justice mishandled.
sections.visual_cue: News headline showing the 3 documents identified.

sections.voiceover: Robert Garcia warned that this missing material undermines government transparency. The report was released 8 days before the election. This timing raises questions about its impact on voters.
sections.visual_cue: Split screen of Rep. Robert Garcia and an election calendar.

sections.voiceover: The 50-page document remains at the center of the investigation.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of a report cover on a desk.
